description: This file is a JavaScript script used for generating and managing test reports, including merging JSON reports, creating HTML reports, uploading artifacts, and sending notifications via webhooks. It interacts with various utilities and environment variables to automate test report workflows in a CI/CD environment.

methods.name: saveReport
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that orchestrates report merging, generation, uploading artifacts, creating test cycles, and sending notifications based on environment variables.
